info.title: Vox Trader Application API
info.description: The application boundary between the Vox backend and its clients. The browser talks to this API and never to a broker. Money crosses as exact decimal strings, never as JSON numbers. A capability without a backend owner answers CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE rather than a plausible success.

ApiError.description: The public error envelope. Never carries provider payloads, credentials or stack traces.

code.description: Stable machine code, screaming snake case.

correlation_id.description: Correlates this response with server logs and with a mutation, when there is one.

details.description: Safe, typed extra context. Never provider metadata.

BrokerAccountDto.description: A broker account discovered through a connection.

broker_account_id.description: Provider broker-account identifier. Metadata, not the capital-command target key.

accessible.description: Whether the runtime can currently read this account.

BrokerEnvironment.description: The broker-side environment of a connection. Exactly the runtime contract's two values.

CancelOrderRequest.description:
Cancel a regular order. Exactly one of `broker_order_id` or `logical_request_id` names
the command being cancelled. `client_request_id` is the identity of *this* cancel.

CandleDto.description: One candle. `closed` distinguishes a settled bar from the one still forming.

opened_at_unix_ms.description: Opening time of the bar, milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

closed.description: False while the bar is still forming. An open bar may be revised.

CandleIntervalDto.description: Candle interval. Only intervals the provider actually serves appear here.

CandlesDto.description: A page of candles for one instrument and interval.

Capability.description: A capability the frontend may gate on.

CapabilitySet.description: What this deployment can actually do, for one scope.

account_id.description: Present when the capability set is account-scoped.

subscription_id.description: Client-generated id, echoed on every event of this subscription.

Decimal.description: Exact decimal value, serialized as a string (`"272.550000000"`, `"-3140.700000000"`).

size_units.description: Size at this level, in instrument units.

cumulative_units.description: Cumulative size from the top of book down to this level.

ErrorCategory.description: The class of failure, which decides what the operator can do about it.

EventPayload.description: The payload of an event, keyed by topic.

ExecutionScope.description:
The immutable target of a read or a capital-affecting command.

`broker_connection_id` is the application connection identity, never a credential.
`account_id` is the canonical Vox account/binding identity. Provider broker-account
identifiers are read-side metadata, not this key.

broker_connection_id.description: Application connection identity. Opaque; never a token.

trading_mode.description: How Vox executes for this scope.

field.description: JSON pointer-ish path of the offending field.

InstrumentIdentityDto.description:
The canonical instrument identity, as the domain defines it.

Identity is `provider` + `uid`. Everything else is an alias for humans and for lookup.

uid.description: The provider's stable instrument identifier. Diagnostics only in normal UI.

figi.description: FIGI where the provider supplies one. An alias, never the identity.

ticker.description: Exchange ticker. Shown to operators; not unique across venues or over time.

class_code.description: Venue or board code that qualifies the ticker.

InstrumentSummaryDto.description:
A catalogue entry: the canonical identity plus what the ticket needs to validate an order.

Lot size and price step are metadata, not UI rules: without them a quantity field would be
guessing, and this API refuses to make the browser guess.

tradable.description: Whether the provider currently lists the instrument as tradable.

JournalStateDto.description: Where a dispatched command stands. `UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH` is an unfinished answer.

MarketFreshness.description:
How current a market-data record is.

Freshness is a property of the feed, not of the instrument, and it is never folded into
the price: a stale quote stays visible with its age rather than disappearing or pretending.

stream.description: Connectivity of the feed that produced this record.

observed_at_unix_ms.description: Event time of the record itself, milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

age_ms.description: Age of the record at the moment the API answered.

MoneyValuationDto.description: One aggregate broker valuation, exact. Not a spendable cash balance.

MutationDecisionDto.description:
Whether the client may submit, must reconcile first, or must not submit at all.
Decided by the backend; the browser never derives it.

MutationReceiptDto.description: The receipt of a capital-affecting command.

logical_request_id.description: Vox-side identity of the command, stable across retries and reconciliation.

scope.description: The frozen target this command was dispatched to.

decision.description: What the backend says the client may do next.

broker_order_id.description: Set only once the broker has answered.

reconciliation_disposition.description: Runtime disposition after reconciliation, when it has run.

OperationDto.description: An operation identity used for reconciliation. Amounts and kinds are owned by #22.

OperationsPageDto.description: A page of operations with the cursor to continue from.

OrderBookDto.description: A book snapshot at one depth.

depth.description: Number of levels the provider returned per side.

oneOf.description: Absolute spread between best bid and best ask, when both sides exist.

OrderDto.description: Order identity and exact provider execution status.

logical_request_id.description: Vox-side identity of the command that created it, when it was ours.

OrderSideDto.description: Which side of the market a command takes. The side is the action, never a mode.

PortfolioDto.description: Portfolio aggregates and authoritative cash balances remain separate.

balances.description: Actual currency balances from GetPositions, never inferred from portfolio aggregates.

PositionDto.description: A position as the broker reports it: instrument and quantity, nothing derived.

ProtectionPlanDto.description: Stop loss and take profit are independent and both optional.

oneOf.description: The entry filled in part, so only part of the position carries protection.

ENTRY_PARTIALLY_FILLED.description: The entry filled in part, so only part of the position carries protection.

oneOf.description: The position is open and its protection did not establish. It is unprotected.

FAILED_AFTER_ENTRY.description: The position is open and its protection did not establish. It is unprotected.

ProtectionStateDto.description:
The canonical protection lifecycle, all ten states.

Two of them carry data and are the two an operator most needs to see: a position that
filled only partly and is therefore only partly protected, and protection that failed
after the position was already open. `STALE` is deliberately absent: staleness is the age
of the last broker answer, carried by stream health, not a lifecycle state.

ProviderDto.description: Providers with a registered adapter. A provider appears here only once it is real.

QuoteDto.description:
Last price and the top of book, with the day's range.

Absent fields mean the provider did not supply them for this instrument, which is a
different thing from a zero and must not be rendered as one.

oneOf.description: Absolute change against the previous close.
Relative change against the previous close, as an exact percentage value.

ReasonCodeDto.description: Why the runtime is in its current state. The only reason vocabulary that exists.

ReconciliationDto.description: How complete the last reconciliation was, per domain.

complete.description: True only when every domain above is complete.

RuntimeHealthDto.description: Everything the shell needs to answer "can I trade right now, and if not why".

reason.description: Human sentence for the operator. The code is the diagnostic, this is the explanation.

account_display.description: Human account label. Raw identifiers stay in diagnostics.

runtime_epoch.description: Monotonic ownership epoch. A response from a previous epoch must be discarded.

execution_authorized.description: Whether Vox execution is authorized for this scope. Not the same as broker permission.

new_exposure_allowed.description: Whether new exposure may be created right now.

RuntimeStateDto.description: Runtime lifecycle. New exposure is permitted in `READY` only.

SafetyConditionDto.description: Why new exposure is blocked, when it is. Authoritative safety facts until #21 lands.

oneOf.description: The full current state of a subscription, sent once on acceptance.

as_of_unix_ms.description: Event time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

runtime_epoch.description: Runtime ownership epoch this event belongs to.

oneOf.description: A change to an already-delivered snapshot.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-subscription sequence, so a gap is detectable.

oneOf.description: A typed failure. Carries no provider internals and no secrets.
Proof of liveness, also the answer to `PING`.

SessionDto.description: The current session for one instrument.

limit_orders_available.description: Whether the venue accepts limit orders right now, when the provider says so.

market_orders_available.description: Whether the venue accepts market orders right now, when the provider says so.

StopOrderDto.description: Stop identity and exact provider status. Provider readback has no logical request identity.

StreamHealthDto.description: Health of one broker stream, including how old its last event is.

last_event_at_unix_ms.description: Event time of the last message, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

StreamKindDto.description: Which broker stream a health record describes.

StreamStateDto.description: Stream connectivity. `STALE` here is a stream fact, never a protection lifecycle state.

SubmitOrderRequest.description: Submit a regular order. Quantity is in lots; price is exact and optional for market orders.

scope.description: The immutable target. A submitted command is never retargeted by a later UI change.

instrument_id.description: Opaque canonical instrument identity. Provider UID/FIGI mapping stays inside adapters.

client_request_id.description: Client-generated identity of this command, used for idempotency and reconciliation.

SubscriptionStatus.description: Why a subscription is in its current status.

SystemHealthDto.description: Liveness of the API process itself, independent of any broker connection.

status.description: Always `"ok"` when the process can serve requests.

api_version.description: Public API version this process serves.

server_time_unix_ms.description: Server time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

Topic.description: Topics a client may subscribe to. A topic exists only when its read model does.

TradeDirectionDto.description: Which side initiated a public trade, where the provider reports it.

TradeTickDto.description: One public trade on the tape.

traded_at_unix_ms.description: Exchange time of the trade, milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

own.description: True when this trade is one of the operator's own, matched by broker fill identity.

TradingMode.description:
How Vox executes, which is not where the broker lives.

Only `LIVE` exists: orders go to the broker connection named by the scope. `PAPER` and
`BACKTEST` are owned by #23 and #29 and will be added here when those runtimes exist,
not before.

TradingStatusDto.description:
Whether the venue is currently accepting orders for an instrument.

This is the venue's session state, not a Vox permission: execution authorization is a
separate fact carried by runtime health.

TrailingDistanceDto.description: A trailing distance: an exact value plus the mode it is measured in.

UnavailableCapability.description: Why a capability is not available, and who owns making it so.

reason.description: Human sentence naming what is missing.

owner.description: The issue that owns the missing contract, for example `#21`.
